behavior_constraints: Per-tensor comparison result must include "shape_mismatch": true when two same-named tensors have different shapes
Shape-mismatched tensor pairs must be treated as non-matching
Top-level compare-outputs "match" must be false when any shape mismatch occurs
When --histogram flag is passed, each per-tensor result must include a "diff_histogram" object with buckets: "exact", "<1e-7", "<1e-5", "<1e-3", "<1", ">=1"
Histogram buckets count element-wise absolute differences
Top-level comparison result must include "histogram_enabled": true when --histogram is active
No diff_histogram is produced for shape-mismatched tensors
entities.summary: This round adds shape-mismatch detection to compare-outputs (reporting shape_mismatch and forcing match=false) and a new --histogram flag that bins element-wise absolute differences into six buckets per tensor.

instruction_head: `compare-outputs` doesn't handle the case where tensors sharing a name have different shapes (e.g., after a model architecture change) — it either crashes or silently compares misaligned values. Add a shape check: if the shapes don't match, the comparison should report `"shape_mismatch": true` in the per-tensor result and treat the pair as non-matching.
